title: a second round the worker cannot see, and a question nobody hears
acceptance: a worker dispatched on a task whose branch already has an open pull request finds that pull request itself, without being told the number
on a later round the prompt carries what review has said and the failing check, whether or not --pr was passed

the lookup keeps GitHub's exit status: answered-and-none carries on and opens a pull request, could-not-answer stops the run before the engine rather than building a blind prompt and pushing at a pull request nobody looked for
the worker's .fm-say.md reaches the pull request on any round where one exists, and the run says which pull request it went to

a message that could not be posted is an error the run reports, not a line on standard error nobody reads: asking is the whole of that round and a question that went nowhere leaves the task deadlocked

the worker's own lookup is the only path there can be: fm-dispatch never restarts a task whose pull request is open, so it has no number to pass, and the suite says so rather than the design claiming it
